unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Left graph y-axis is labeled 'Body weight (g)', giving units in grams. Right graph y-axis shows LW/BW and FW/BW, which are dimensionless ratios of organ weight to body weight.

explanation.explanation: Panel B shows representative gross (photographic) images of mouse abdomens, not a quantitative plot with axes.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O staining micrographs, not a quantitative plot with axes.
Panel D shows a 5mC dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a quantitative plot with axes.

unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Y-axis is labeled '5mC/Methylene Blue (ratio)', a dimensionless ratio that does not require units.
Y-axis of the bar graph is labeled 'Ratio (TETs/GAPDH)', a dimensionless ratio that does not require units. The blot image above shows molecular weight markers in kDa, which are not plot axes.
